notes.drawing: Direction A from batch 6: a dish facing up and to the right on a stand. The dish is a half-disc (radius 84, turned 45 degrees, centre 128,112) built like the satellite's dish, with a feed arm 48 long ending in Phosphor's solid dot (radius 4 plus the stroke); the stand runs from the back of the dish (128,196) to a foot from x 84 to 172 at y 224. No signal arcs: the maintainer picked the direction without them, and with arcs it comes close to broadcast and wifi-high.
notes.dot: A zero-length line at the dot's centre (as in chat-warning) makes the browser paint the bold dot solid, so compare's outline check matches the build's solid disc.
notes.fill: Dish solid, feed arm, dot and stand as lines.
